source_revision: not-reviewed: provider terms not read; automation surface per Moonshot's Kimi Code CLI documentation (kimi.com/code/docs, retrieved 2026-10-13, sources K1 to K13 in docs/research/kimi-code-spike-2026-10-13.md) as recorded in TDD 4.7, the 2026-10-15 live checks (docs/research/live-checks-2026-10-15-kimi.md, Kimi Code CLI 2.1.1) and ADR-0049
notes: Added by T4.62 (2026-10-15, Delegated agent work, not owner-approved). The range admits no version (ADR-0009, FR-ADP-09): the adapter fails the version gate with ADAPTER_VERSION_UNVERIFIED until T4.68 runs `switchboard adapters validate kimi` against a live CLI, so nothing here is a claim that any Kimi Code version is validated. Automation surfaces (ADR-0049): `kimi --prompt=<prompt> --output-format stream-json` (always Never Ask, so bypass-class: compiled only for an approved privileged scope that sets bypass, with nothing added to restrict it) and `kimi acp` (ACP over stdio, ADR-0036 client) for restricted runs; `kimi --version` for the version. Flags cited by TDD 4.7 source K1 and observed in `--help` in the 2026-10-15 live check: -p/--prompt, --output-format (text, stream-json), -m/--model, -S/--session, and the `acp` subcommand. ACP session modes observed: default, plan, auto, yolo; auto and yolo are bypass-class and never set. Never emitted: -p (the long --prompt is used), --yolo, -y, --auto, --plan, --continue, --agent, --agent-file, --skills-dir, --add-dir, `acp --login`; KIMI_CODE_HOME stays out of the environment (ADR-0003). The argv audit refuses --yolo, -y, --auto and --plan outside an approved privileged bypass run, and the ACP plan audit refuses modes auto and yolo (registry entry). -p and --prompt are not declared to the audit: the audit is shared by all providers and Claude Code's -p and Antigravity's --prompt are ordinary flags there (open question in ROADMAP T4.62); the compile gate alone keeps --prompt to the approved bypass cell. Compile matrix (Delegated, fail closed): inspect-untrusted, edit-untrusted, test-sandboxed and trusted-development are Ineligible (PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED): no sandbox or network control exists, and the project's .kimi-code/mcp.json stdio servers start once the workspace is trusted with no per-run flag to disable them. privileged with bypass compiles only for an approved scope with worktree files, shell broad, network on and repository_config enabled. privileged without bypass compiles `kimi acp` only with network on and repository_config enabled: mode plan for read-only files, default otherwise, every session/request_permission answered by the controller; T4.68 showed default mode does not ask (Kimi Code 2.1.1, post-#748 rerun), so since the owner ruling of 2026-10-19 08:45 CDT that cell is Ineligible (PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED, 'Kimi has no permission requests') and Kimi Code is bypass-only (ADR-0049 item 3; kimiBypassOnlyGate in src/adapters/kimi/adapter.ts). Auth (T4.64): the ACP initialize then session/new probe of ADR-0049 item 4; UNKNOWN until then. Parser and resume (T4.63): not yet; a clean exit is OUTPUT_PROTOCOL_ERROR and resume is Ineligible. Git writes (FR-GIT-01): no declared control (ADR-0039); commitChannel finalize-only. Credentials: Switchboard never reads, copies, logs or exports Kimi Code credentials (under KIMI_CODE_HOME), never starts login and never scrapes dashboards (ADR-0003, FR-AUTH-02). Terms: this manifest records that the CLI documents headless and ACP use (technical evidence only); it makes no claim that any use complies with Moonshot's terms (NFR-COMP-01). Review date: 2026-10-15 (Delegated agent review, not owner-approved). Linux only; macOS (NFR-PORT-02) and Windows (NFR-PORT-03) are not supported. Evidence (adapters validate, 2026-10-18): `switchboard adapters validate kimi` passed on version 2.1.1: probe steps binary, version, command, output_format, flags ok, auth OK, static conformance checks ok and one structured-output smoke call ok (approved privileged bypass cell, owner decision 59; inspect-untrusted is Ineligible). The range is the same minor series (Q-12 convention, an Assumption, not a provider statement).
